sections.note: rc1c2c5 [2x1] alternating → variant of same block

proposed_rules.trigger: A vertical stack of uniform question rows (each a short heading, often with an expand affordance), typically under an 'FAQ' heading; visual tree marks the container [presentation] with N equal-height children.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit ONE accordion block with one row per Q/A pair. The question is the row's first cell; the answer (may be collapsed/under-rendered) the second — confirm answer text via Phase 2.
proposed_rules.rationale: FAQ accordions are a canonical reusable block; each item is one row, matching EDS table-per-item authoring.

proposed_rules.trigger: A sequence of full-width [2x1] rows each pairing an image and a text column, where the image/text sides alternate down the page.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat every row as the same 'feature' block; express the left/right alternation as a variant label (e.g. feature (image-left)), not as distinct blocks.
proposed_rules.rationale: Alternating media rows are the same content structure mirrored via CSS — a variant, not a new block, per variant-is-css-not-new-block.

notes: Richest long-tail page seen: 8 distinct block types. solution/solution-2/solution-3 share this structure → one template family. Two generic blocks (accordion, alternating-feature) not yet in rulebook — high-value proposals since they recur across many marketing pages.
